reviews.comment: This class was lecture heavy but all of the lecture slides were posted. Attendance was mandatory. She was an alright professor but would not take this class again because it was a little difficult.

She's awesome! The class was extremely well organized. There were very few assignments outside of class besides the weekly readings. Just show up, take notes, and do the readings and you will easily get A's on the exams. She made her lectures interesting and easy to follow!
stopped listening to lectures and doing readings but still got an A, super easy class
Poll everywhere is used for attendance and you can do it at home. 2 exams in class and a couple of short essays over the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was average overall. The class was fine, though not especially engaging. She uses polls to take attendance and mainly follows the content on the slides during lectures.

I must concur with the others that this was not a great class. Simas just reads off the slides and often stumbles around and gets confused about the material. Would recommend taking a different class with different instuctor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, I enjoyed her class! Show up to class for slides. She answers questions. Simplified lectures/slides easy to understand. Make sure to take notes during class & skim the textbook bc a few concepts in reading hw weren't fully covered in class but on exams. Slight curves but try to do well bc there are few grades for the course.

Ignore the bad reviews!!!!! Dr. Simas' class was enjoyable and easy. You can tell that polling is her specialty, so I would love to take a class where she teaches that in some regard. Her exams were pretty easy and there were very little assignments. Just read your textbook and go to class, which assuming most of the bad reviews didn't!

The epitome of middle of the road. Very heavily exam skewed that you definitely had to take notes on and pay attention but not too difficult. Attendance was mandatory. She does not post her lecture notes so while it is technically possible to pass the class without ever going, Good luck! If you passed US gov,this class should be easy enough for you

She's a very nice woman, but what she teaches doesn't correlate with her exams. She WILL NOT post lecture slides or any sort of review for the 2 exams in her class so be ready to take good notes. It's not a difficult course if you put in effort, but you're kinda on your own

I didn't have a great experience with this professor in this class. The reading assignments were simple. Attendance is mandatory for your grade. However, the correlation between the lectures/books and exams were off. It felt overcomplicated and confusing. She doesn't really set you up for success. Don't recommend.

ignore the bad reviews, she's great!

 due to some advising/scheduling hiccups i took this class as a senior. take decent notes and study a few days prior to each exam, and there shouldn't be any reason to not get an A. a FEW test questions are a little confusing and offbeat, but that's my only complaint.

Dr. Simas is not as bad as these reviews are making her sound. She does read off the slides, but the slides are straight forward. if you go to class and put even just a little effort in, you should get a good grade. She does not post slides, so don't miss class, but if you do, most material covered is in one of the two required textbooks.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the only class I've experienced poor grades on exams. It seems like Dr Simas took the course description and just threw it all together. The midterm and the final were ridiculous to me because they weren't even over what she emphasized throughout the lectures. Majority of the test questions are theoretical statements mentioned maybe once.

Terrible teacher and orator. Reads directly from the slides and sounds like she doesn't know what she's talking about. Gets facts wrong often and gets tripped up if she loses her place on the slides. She just repeats herself over and over in her annoying voice. Don't miss class. Impossible to study because she refuses to post her slides.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While attendance was mandatory, only 60% was necessary for full credit. With that being said, it made up 30% of the final grade, which in my opinion is extremely excessive. Just showing up should not constitute that much of a grade, and it is a lazy course design. Don't make my mistake, attend classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The papers are pretty easy, they are short and over the movies watched in class. Attendance is answering 60% of the Poll Everywhere in class. My #1 issue with Prof. Simas is that she doesn't post slides or any kind of lecture material. She also doesn't give a test review. If you show up and take good notes you will do well.

amazing professor, attendance not rlly mandatory since she only requires 60% of poll everywhere responses to be considered full credit for participation. take notes in class, she doesn't post them. lectures are very entertaining and so are the movies she picks for us to watch. exams are also easy if u take notes and read textbook. take her class !!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Decent but she seems to resent being a teacher. Will NOT post any course material or provide guidance on studying for tests, which is a huge problem because the only things she grades are those tests. Attendance is more important than anything else in the class since its's weighted for 30% of your final grade
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Simas was not a bad professor but you do need to attend class! She does like 5 polls a class and they count for attendance, I missed one day and my grade was brought down 8 points. Very lecture heavy and DOES NOT POST THE SLIDES, so either go to class or get them from a friend because the exams rely heavily on the slides and her textbook.
